documents.title: ADR 0001: Platform and Build
documents.description: Follows the newest GA .NET release (today .NET 11 and C# 15) pinned in global.json, with Central Package Management, lock files, a 72-hour NuGet minimum publish age, warnings as errors, a single .editorconfig, locked CI restore and C# file-based scripts.

documents.title: ADR 0002: Aspire, Configuration and Infrastructure
documents.description: Makes Aspire 17 mandatory with a Microsoft.NET.Sdk AppHost using AddDotnetProject, sets validated options, Aspire parameters and managed identity for configuration and secrets, and makes Aspire the only infrastructure code.

documents.title: ADR 0003: Solution Structure
documents.description: Prescribes one solution shape: a modular monolith with feature slices per module, .slnx only, root tests/ only and Data.{Provider} project naming.

documents.title: ADR 0004: HTTP API
documents.description: Prescribes Minimal APIs with endpoint classes, OpenAPI 3.2 with Scalar, built-in minimal-API validation, Problem Details for every error and clients generated from OpenAPI.

documents.title: ADR 0005: Application Layer
documents.description: Prescribes hand-rolled CQRS handlers without MediatR, a C# 15 union Result<T> matched with an exhaustive switch, and an injected TimeProvider.

documents.title: ADR 0006: Persistence and Messaging
documents.description: Prescribes EF Core only in Data.{Provider} projects, a concurrency token per aggregate, migrations through an AppHost runner, fix-forward after migration, and outbox-based at-least-once messaging with idempotent consumers.

documents.title: ADR 0007: Observability and Resilience
documents.description: Prescribes OpenTelemetry through ServiceDefaults with the Aspire dashboard locally, [LoggerMessage] logging, the standard HTTP resilience handler and Polly v8 only for non-HTTP adapters.

documents.title: ADR 0008: Security
documents.description: Prescribes an external OIDC identity provider with full JWT validation and PKCE, zero-trust named policies checked per call with resource-based checks and audit, and rate limiting on every public or anonymous endpoint.

documents.title: ADR 0009: Frontend
documents.description: Sets frontend rules rather than a framework: its own app under src/App/ run as an Aspire resource, a generated OpenAPI client, design/ tokens as CSS variables and a component catalog, with Blazor or React 19 + Vite + Tailwind 4 picked per app.

documents.title: ADR 0010: Testing
documents.description: Prescribes xUnit v3 on Microsoft Testing Platform with NSubstitute and Bogus, integration tests on one module Api with WebApplicationFactory and throwaway containers, and a Playwright E2E suite as the only tests run through aspire start.

documents.title: ADR 0011: Setting Up MCP
documents.description: Prescribes stateless Streamable HTTP MCP servers on the C# SDK 2.x with their own skill, two-way communication, OAuth 2.1 with CIMD and PKCE, agent-plus-user authorization through RFC 8693, annotated tools, rate limits and a per-call audit record.

documents.title: ADR 0012: Agents in Applications
documents.description: Prescribes Microsoft Agent Framework on Microsoft.Extensions.AI with Foundry behind one adapter, in-process agents by default, tools only from the app own MCP servers or handlers, A2A, human-in-the-loop, GenAI telemetry and baseline evaluation in CI.

documents.title: ADR 0013: Agent-Ready Repository
documents.description: Prescribes one AGENTS.md wrapped per host with path-scoped rules, Aspire skills from aspire agent init used CLI first, dotnet/skills, and an .mcp.json that runs the guidelines server through dnx.

documents.title: ADR Number Map
documents.description: Maps each retired ADR number 0001 to 0019 to the consolidated ADR that replaces it.

documents.title: Agent Skill Authoring: Scope, Preconditions, and Descriptions
documents.description: Rules for writing SKILL.md descriptions and preconditions so an agent cannot wrongly exclude a skill that should apply. Covers narrowing scope by work type rather than process maturity, when negative scope is legitimate, Stage 0 scope discovery for missing inputs, stop conditions that route to a successor, anti-patterns, and a pass/fail audit checklist.

documents.title: 02 Constraints
documents.description: Fixes the givens every app starts from: the newest GA .NET, Aspire 17, EF Core in Data.{Provider} projects and Azure as the target deployed by aspire deploy.

documents.title: 04 Solution Strategy
documents.description: Maps each goal to its approach — one modular-monolith shape with feature slices, Result<T> handlers, pragmatic domain-driven design — and the path for extracting a module.

documents.title: 05 Building Block View
documents.description: Prescribes the one solution structure: the src/ and tests/ tree, the Contoso.Orders example, the blocks, the dependency rules and the naming conventions.

documents.title: Building Block: Module
documents.description: Prescribes a module's implementation and Abstractions projects, its feature-slice layout, handler and registration shape, and its boundary rules.

documents.title: Building Block: Domain Model
documents.description: Prescribes aggregate roots that guard invariants through Result-returning methods, value objects only where they earn it, domain events, specifications and their tests.

documents.title: Building Block: Api
documents.description: Prescribes a module Api project: one endpoint class per feature slice, an exhaustive Result<T> to Problem Details mapping and a Program.cs that only composes.

documents.title: Building Block: Data.{Provider}
documents.description: Prescribes the {Module}.Data.{Provider} project: EF Core mapping outside the entities, one repository per aggregate, concurrency tokens, the outbox and migrations.

documents.title: Building Block: AppHost
documents.description: Prescribes the Microsoft.NET.Sdk AppHost with Aspire.Hosting.Dotnet and AddDotnetProject, the migration runner, resource commands and browser logs.

documents.title: Building Block: ServiceDefaults
documents.description: Prescribes the ServiceDefaults project as the one place for OpenTelemetry, health endpoints, service discovery and the standard HTTP resilience handler.

documents.title: Building Block: Test Harness
documents.description: Prescribes a Fake* adapter for integration tests and a harness project the AppHost starts in run mode for every external service the app does not own.

documents.title: Building Block: Notifications
documents.description: Prescribes notifications as stored records sent and retried by a background worker, with push carrying only a nudge and the client re-reading through the API.

documents.title: Building Block: File Storage
documents.description: Prescribes an IFileStorage port with an Azure Blob Storage adapter hosted through Aspire, metadata in the module database and no public containers.

documents.title: 07 Deployment View
documents.description: Makes Aspire the infrastructure code deployed with aspire deploy to Azure Container Apps, with per-environment secrets, a GitHub Actions pipeline, weekly grouped Dependabot updates with an Aspire group, auto-merge gated by required checks, and the rule to roll back only while the schema is unchanged.

documents.title: 08 Crosscutting Concepts
documents.description: Prescribes one answer per crosscutting concern, each linked to its ADR: caching, feature flags, idempotency, API versioning, logging and audit, background jobs, validation, testing, code style and domain code, time, concurrency, real-time updates as nudge-and-re-read, and secrets at rest.

documents.title: Instruction-File Setup: One AGENTS.md, Wrapped per Host
documents.description: Prescribes one root AGENTS.md as the only authored instruction file, CLAUDE.md as an @AGENTS.md import and .github/copilot-instructions.md as a one-sentence pointer, path-scoped rules authored once under .agents/rules/ with a wrapper per host, MCP-first selection with disclosed fallback, and the migration from a Copilot-only file.

documents.title: GitHub Copilot Agent Configuration (github-app.yml)
documents.description: Standard configuration guideline for github-app.yml: mandatory pre-PR validation steps (restore, build, test), post-PR CI monitoring with auto-fix loop, review comment handling, PR conventions, and agent safety boundaries.

documents.title: MCP Server Configuration (.mcp.json)
documents.description: Standard .mcp.json setup for GitHub Copilot CLI, including required fields, baseline server entries for Microsoft Learn, JSdotNet Guidelines, and Aspire, plus maintenance best practices.

documents.title: Style Guide: Color Palette
documents.description: Color tokens for light and dark mode: brand, semantic, text, background, and border groups with hex values and usage rules.

documents.title: Style Guide: Typography
documents.description: Font families (Inter, Poppins, Fira Code), size scale, weights, line heights, and heading defaults.

documents.title: Style Guide: Spacing and Layout
documents.description: 4 px base spacing scale, 12-column layout grid, breakpoints, border radius, border width, shadows, and z-index scale.

documents.title: Style Guide: Motion and Interaction
documents.description: Transition durations, easing curves, standard transition presets, focus states, reduced-motion rules, and loading indicator patterns.

documents.title: Style Guide: Customization Guide
documents.description: Rules for overriding brand and semantic color tokens per project, including the override contract, contrast requirements, and step-by-step process.

documents.title: Style Guide: Component Patterns
documents.description: Reusable UI component specifications: Button, Form Input, Card, Badge/Chip, and Toast — covering anatomy, states, variants, and accessibility requirements.

documents.title: Style Guide: Iconography
documents.description: Lucide icon library rules: sizing scale, color conventions using currentColor, accessibility requirements for icon-only and icon+label elements.

documents.title: Style Guide: Voice and Tone
documents.description: Language personality, grammar rules, button label patterns, error message structure, empty state copy, confirmation dialog copy, and capitalization reference.

documents.title: Style Guide: Interaction Patterns
documents.description: Standard UX patterns for form validation, empty states, loading states, error handling, and navigation (tabs, breadcrumbs, modals, drawers, drag-and-drop).

documents.title: Style Guide: Overview
documents.description: Entry point to the UX style guide: structure overview, customization policy, design principles, and platform scope.
